title: Minecraft Whitelist Command Generator | Add Multiple Players
description: Generate Minecraft whitelist commands for adding, removing, enabling, or disabling whitelist access for multiple players.
intro: Paste player names and generate whitelist commands for small events, private SMPs, and staff-managed servers.
howTo: Paste player names, one per line.
Choose whether to add, remove, enable, disable, or reload whitelist.
Copy the generated commands into console.
faqs: A whitelist limits server access to approved players.
Can I add multiple players at once?
Minecraft usually needs one command per player, so this tool generates the list for you.
Should I use usernames or UUIDs?
For normal server commands, usernames are commonly used. Some server panels may support UUID-based management.
